text:
aisha_cs: Quick heads-up — Cynosure wants to join our upcoming cohort but SSO legal appendix is holding full seat provisioning. They asked if we can enroll 8 users temporarily and run an accelerated feedback loop. Need a short plan: temp access, async survey, enablement slots, and flag renewal risk. Thoughts?

marco_csm: Checked with their IT — SSO PO signed but legal needs a SAML appendix. ETA ~3 business days. Temporary guest accounts are fine from their side if we scope them to non-prod.

devon_success: Guest accounts + IP allowlist should do it. I can draft the compliance caveat. Do we need data isolation or token scoping for these guests? :thinking_face:

priya_enablement: I can run two 30-min onboarding sessions (Tue/Thu) and publish async materials in Notion. Draft agenda: 1) quick product tour 2) prompt examples for their use-cases 3) how to monitor usage/cost. Will include a 48h pulse survey.

marco_csm: +1. Proposed pulse survey (48h post-session) — short 3 Qs. Sample snippet:```
Q1: How easy was the onboarding (1-5)?
Q2: Did the initial responses meet your team's expectations (Yes/No)?
Q3: Any blockers or missing features? (free text)
```

onboard-bot: Invite scheduled — enablement sessions created and invites sent to cynthia@cynosure.com for Tue 10:00 AM PST and Thu 2:00 PM PST. Calendar links posted. :calendar:

devon_success: I'll own the temporary access playbook and the token scoping instructions. Draft will include commands to revoke guest tokens and an audit checklist.

priya_enablement: Sharing draft survey link for review: https://tiny.redwood/cynosure-pulse — pls comment before EOD. Also adding an async walkthrough recording to Notion.

marco_csm: I'll follow up with legal and update here. If appendix timeline slips, recommend a 2-week guest extension with low-privilege accounts to keep momentum and avoid renewal friction.

aisha_cs: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: devon_success -> temp access playbook, priya_enablement -> publish Notion + survey, marco_csm -> legal follow-up. I'll mark the account "renewal_monitor" in our tracker and set a check-in for Day 14. :thumbsup: 

priya_enablement: Done — Notion published and I added the survey to the enablement email template. Pinged Cynosure PM.

marco_csm: Legal replied — SAML appendix draft sent, expect sign-off tomorrow morning. I'll post final status after signature.

devon_success: Playbook draft ready and pushed to the shared folder. Including revoke commands and audit steps.

aisha_cs: Great work. We'll reconvene only if legal slips or Cynosure reports issues from the pulse. Otherwise we'll log outcomes after Day 14. :eyes:
